Getting to Chiang Khan Walking Street from Bangkok

From Bangkok

Mode: Flight + road Duration: About 4–5 hours
  • Fly Bangkok (DMK/BKK) to Loei Airport (LOE)
  • Taxi or shared ride ~1.5h to Chiang Khan
  • Or take an overnight bus straight to Chiang Khan (~10–11h)
